sentences.text:
Coram : N. J. Jamadar, J.
 Date : December 21, 2023
Heard the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned App for the State.

2. This application is preferred seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 1417 of 2022
registered at Hadapsar police station for the offences punishable under sections 328, 272 and 273 of
Indian penal Code, 1860 and sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 3(1) (zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and
Standards Act, 2006.

3. The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with the aforesaid crime as the co-accused in
whose possession the contraband articles - Gutakha Pan masala, has been seized, has named the
applicant as the person who supplied the contraband articles.

4. The learned Counsel for the applicant submit that the Vishal Parekar ...1 1-aba-3385-2022.doc
applicability of Section 328 of Ipc is debatable.
5.  The learned APP seeks time to take instructions about the antecedents of the applicant.

sentences.text:

bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
7. The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and report to the Hadapsar Police Station on every Sunday in between 10.00 a.m. to 12.00 noon till the next date.
8. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the prosecution witnesses or the persons acquainted with the facts of the case.
